Definition: to cut in pieces, i.e. slaughter
BiblicalUsage: Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal, finishing the judgment Saul had refused to carry out. The word is a single violent stroke, cutting a man to pieces as an act of God's justice.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe delayed obedience is disobedience, and Samuel's sword finished what Saul's mercy had left undone.
